name: @fuaran-ui/validator
description: Build-time validator for TypeScript-authored Fuaran UI trees — a TypeScript-compiler-API source walker over the @fuaran-ui/ui smart-constructor surface. Surfaces the same FUARAN### defect codes as the F# tier's Fuaran.UI.Validator for the portable rule subset (NodeId uniqueness, manifest-gated query/dispatch resolution, Tabs shape, blank href, no-op disabled binding, blank currency code, dangerous extra-attribute keys, out-of-range progress, redundant grid template-columns). Runs as a CLI (fuaran-validate) and a programmatic API.
author: Andrew J. Willshire <andrew@fuaran.com> (Diametrical Ltd)
